description: Implementation of the TaxRateService interface, providing business logic for managing tax rates in the application. The class extends a generic service implementation and interacts with the TaxRateDao to perform database operations related to tax rates, such as listing by store, retrieving by code, or filtering by country, zone, and tax class.

classes.name: TaxRateServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that manages tax rate operations, extending generic entity service and implementing specific tax rate functionalities.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves all tax rates associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves all tax rates associated with a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a tax rate by its code for a specific store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Fetches tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Fetches tax rates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.
